learning_outcomes.text: Recognize various characteristics of AC electrical circuits.
Understand and perform calculations for three-phase systems.
Learn the concept and types of power.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental expressions and concepts, Phasor concept
Phasor connections of circuit elements, Phasor Diagrams
RLC Circuits, Series Parallel circuits, Power Definitions
Definitions of Apparent, Active, Reactive power, Power Factor correction
Balanced, Unbalanced Three-phase circuits, load connections, power relationships
Laplace transform and its application to circuits
bibliography: Basic Engineering Circuit Analysis , Dawid Irwin, Wiley Serisi
Electric Circuit Analysis, David E. Johnson, Prentice Hall
Introductory Circuit Analysis, Robert Boylestad, Prentice Hall
Elektrik Devreleri, Schaum Outlines, Çev: Timur Aydemir, Cem Nakiboğlu
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
